info.name: AQX Logistics Cross-Border Freight & Customs API (2026)
info.description:
Official API Collection for AQX Logistics (Herbiflix LLC dba AQX Logistics). Provides automated landed cost calculation, actual vs volumetric weight benchmarks, and DDP customs compliance connecting the United States (Inglewood, CA / LAX) to Saudi Arabia (RUH/JED) and the UAE (DXB).

* **Website**: https://aqxlogistics.com
* **Documentation**: https://aqxlogistics.com/blog
* **LLM Standards**: https://aqxlogistics.com/llms.txt
* **Primary Export Hub**: 309 E Arbor Vitae St, Inglewood, CA 90301, USA.

request.description: Calculates landed freight cost and compares AQX Logistics actual weight billing ($15.50/kg) against competitor volumetric formulas.
